participants.name: Misaki

persona.name: Misaki
persona.personality: Misaki has a calm personality and tends to deal with things in a cool-headed manner. She may seem a little unfriendly at times, but she is actually very kind at heart and does not hesitate to lend a helping hand to those in need. She does not express her emotions outwardly and does not talk much about her relationships with those around her, but she is often relied upon by those close to her. She can be a little absent-minded at times, but her quiet demeanor is one of her charms.

participants.private_seed: Money has been leaving this partnership faster than any plan allowed for, and each quarter seems to end with less room than it began with. Before this cheque goes out I want to know what the years after a first round demand of us, and what we can borrow against when they do.

participants.name: Shion

persona.name: Shion
persona.personality: Shion is very confident and often acts calmly and calculatingly. On the surface, he is quiet and good at observing others' movements, but deep down he wants to be the center of attention. He sometimes shows a slightly challenging attitude toward those around him and tends to want to do things at his own pace. In addition, he does not show his emotions much and is the type of person who judges things coldly and logically. The occasional smile he shows hides a charm that surprises those around him.

participants.private_seed: Nearly everything in the last two cohorts arrived late, and never for the reason written in the plan — something outside the team's own hands always sat between the money going in and a first customer switching anything on. I would rather know now which kind of obstacle we are signing ourselves up for.

participants.name: Shizue

persona.name: Shizue
persona.personality: Shizue has a very calm and gentle personality. Even as she has grown older, she continues to smile warmly at those around her and is a very caring person. She is always considerate of others, friendly, and sometimes shows a playful side. She often reaches out to those who are feeling down with kind words and never hesitates to lend a helping hand when needed, which has earned her the affection of many people in the village and community. Through her years of life experience, Shizue has come to understand the importance of living peacefully with others.

participants.private_seed: The stories we tell about our wins have drifted a long way from what the returns actually came from. I keep wanting to walk back through everything already funded and see which of it kept its customers and which quietly did not.

participants.name: Mizuki

persona.name: Mizuki
persona.personality: Mizuki is a very confident woman who is often relied upon by those around her. She is calm and logical in her thinking and is good at observing people. As a result, she always makes calm judgments and chooses her actions according to the situation around her. Although she may sometimes come across as a little aloof, she is actually very caring and cannot ignore those who are weak. While she is relied upon by those around her and occasionally asserts her opinions strongly, she also possesses a kindness that considers others.

participants.private_seed: Our own quarter-end has become the worst fortnight of every three months, and much of it goes on numbers nobody here can check independently. Before adding to the book I want a clear view of what a new holding does to the way we close and report.

participants.name: Jonathan

persona.name: Jonathan
persona.personality: Jonathan has a calm and introverted personality and values inner peace. He prefers spending quiet time alone rather than forming deep connections with others. As a result, he loves books and knowledge and reads frequently. When interacting with others, he is gentle and kind, occasionally flashing an unexpected smile. Though he exudes a mysterious and serene aura, he rarely shares personal details about himself with others. Those around him often find comfort in his quiet kindness and composed demeanor.

participants.private_seed: Every company we back ends up asking us for people, and lately the asking takes more of the week than the deciding does. I want a straight look at who can actually be found right now and whose time here is left to give.

You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Selection of a seed-stage company for a venture fund's next investment. Five partners at an early-stage venture fund review the companies that cleared the final screening round. One company will receive this quarter's seed investment. Participants: Misaki, Shion, Shizue, Mizuki and Jonathan. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Reserve accounts and follow-on calls
- Terms of last winter's credit line
- Security review time before first deployment
- Delivery records of two holdings
- Profile of the exits and the write-off
- Account retention through price rises
- Appraisal needs at the last audit
- Independent checks on holdings' reported figures
- Retained recruiters' placement times
- Adviser bench and partner board seats

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Mizuki, Jonathan, Shizue, Misaki and Shion. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
